## About
Marcel's is an auto body, paint and collision shop in Miami, run by Marcel and his wife Ana. Not every collision is the same, but every car gets the same care and attention, and all makes and models are welcome.
After an accident, it helps to have someone in your corner. We accept all insurance companies and understand their procedures, but we work for you, not the insurance company. We can arrange a tow and help you set up a rental car so the process stays as smooth as possible.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 63 Google reviews. One reviewer put it simply: this family owned business truly treats you like family.

## Services
- Free estimates: Call to make an appointment, or email your contact info, vehicle info and photos.
- Free towing within Miami-Dade County: We can set up a tow to our shop at no charge when the repair is done with us within Miami-Dade County.
- Heavy collision repair: Full structural and body repair after an accident, with the goal of returning your car to its pre-accident condition.
- Auto body repairs: Body work for all makes and models.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent repair without repainting the panel.
- Paint matching: Paint work done with the same care as a major repair.
- Rental car assistance: We can help you set up a rental car while yours is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you accept my insurance company?
A: Yes. We accept all insurance companies and understand their procedures, and we work directly for you and represent your best interest.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Venmo and insurance checks.

Q: I need a tow truck. Can you help?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we can set up a tow truck to pick up your car at no charge to you within Miami-Dade County. Tow companies not set up by us or you may take your car to a storage yard or shop of their choosing, which can lead to unnecessary fees.

Q: Can I choose the repair shop?
A: Yes. You have the right to choose the facility that repairs your vehicle.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Call us to make an appointment, or email us your contact info, vehicle info and photos.
